name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 55 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.3 days starting 2025-12-12, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
